nodes.rationale: All OCR model inference runs on pinned Hugging Face endpoints; the local laptop prepares inputs, orchestrates requests, validates and stores witnesses, evaluates outputs, and supports review, but never runs OCR models or silently falls back to local weights.

nodes.label: Page-Local Truth
nodes.rationale: Design principle that correctness is established first at the page level before broader document stitching.

nodes.label: Product Boundary
nodes.rationale: In scope: OCR orchestration and witness production. Out of scope: morphology, dictionary semantics, lexicographic normalization, full document-semantic extraction, document-specific structured transforms, and acting as a general structured-data transformer.

nodes.label: PAGE Interchange
nodes.rationale: OCR-D PAGE-compatible internal representation used when it reduces custom orchestration or review work; public output remains JSON and Markdown rather than requiring XML.

nodes.label: ADR 0010 Structured Output Boundary
nodes.rationale: V1 standardizes on bochord's own evidence-preserving OCR intermediate as layer 1; layers 2 and 3 belong in downstream packages. Rejected a universal target schema or XML-first workflow.

nodes.label: Layer 1 Evidence-Preserving OCR Intermediate
nodes.rationale: Canonical v1 output comprising prepared source artifacts, raw witness artifacts, accepted page graph, review and evaluation metadata, and standard export families. OCR orchestration and evidence preservation must complete before domain-specific structural commitments are safe.

nodes.label: Layers 2 and 3 Downstream Transforms
nodes.rationale: Optional transformation profiles and target-domain consumer models belong in downstream packages (dictionary, grammar, reader). Domain models live outside the core until broad reuse is proven.

nodes.label: TEI P5 Dictionary Guidance
nodes.rationale: Structural reference for downstream lexical work; not a v1 requirement to emit TEI XML. Downstream packages may express TEI-inspired concepts as Python or Pydantic models.

nodes.label: ADR 0008 Stable IDs and Review History
nodes.norm_label: adr 0008 stable ids and review history

nodes.label: Universal Target Schema Alternative
nodes.rationale: Rejected alternative: a universal target schema or XML-first workflow that forces all consumers into one downstream ontology or TEI vocabulary regardless of document genre.

nodes.label: Architecture Documentation Index
nodes.rationale: Ordered reading path: ADRs for stable product and architecture boundaries first, then specs for concrete v1 implementation details.

nodes.label: Spec 0006 Exports and Retrieval Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Generate deterministic bundle-adjacent RAG JSON/JSONL and evidence-preserving Markdown from accepted page graphs, with traceable provenance, trust, footnotes, and stitched chunks. Sequence 4 of 5; obeys Spec 0011 boundary; Spec 0016 freezes model JSON afterward.

nodes.label: DocumentExportService
nodes.rationale: Pure service that derives RagDocument and Markdown from DocumentBundle; does not mutate DocumentBundle or page graph; never reads raw witness text as document text.

nodes.label: BundleLayoutService
nodes.rationale: Owns exports paths and atomic JSON helpers; write_document_exports instantiates DocumentExportService and persists derived views.

nodes.label: StitchedChunk
nodes.rationale: One stitched main-text chunk only for a contiguous region-kind run spanning at least two pages; never includes footnote chunks; page order from DocumentBundle.pages then accepted region order.

nodes.label: Spec 0011 Boundary Constraint
nodes.rationale: Plan obeys Spec 0011 boundary: no TEI/XML serializer, no domain-specific dictionary/grammar model, no search/index integration; semantic consumer transforms belong in downstream packages.
